source_handle: 5. Remove decay, open the pulp, uncover the top of the pulp, detect one root canal orifice, and pull out the pulp; measure the length of the root canal 21mm electrically, and prepare the file to No. 0435; rinse and blot dry, and temporarily seal with calcium hydroxide.
